ICC sanctions Powell and Rutherford for Code of Conduct breaches

The International Cricket Council (ICC) has sanctioned Rovman Powell and Sherfane Rutherford for breaches of the Code of Conduct during the second T20 International match against India. The specific nature of the breaches and the exact sanctions were not detailed in the provided coverage.
